_note: C-229 moving and storing built buildings (design SEN-C-227 D-555 README §5, owner SEN-Q-344 D1–D3): move_building checks the new spot as place_building does, its own old cells not counting, and keeps animals, drops and timers; store_building gives back the blueprint and the rules' materials, laid drops into the bag, never the cottage, never while a drop is on its way. Each case runs through server/src/parcels/farm.ts (server/test/parcels/farm.test.ts) and modules/dynamic_farm/parcel_farm.gd (tests/dynamic_farm/test_building_arrange.gd); both must give `expect`. Generated by the server rules: tools/dev/dynamic_farm/arrange_cases.ts.
